name: Pope Alexander I
role: Head of the Catholic Church from c. 107 to c. 115
contribution: The bishop of Rome from about 108/09 to 116/19.

checks.lead: Pope Alexander I (Greek: Αλέξανδρος, died c. 115) was the bishop of Rome from about 108/09 to 116/19 (according to the 2012 Annuario Pontificio). Some believe he suffered martyrdom under the Roman emperor Trajan or Hadrian.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
